POSTGRES_USER.description: Postgres superuser name. Also used by Paperless-ngx to connect (PGUSER).

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Postgres password. Auto-generated. Also used by Paperless-ngx to connect (PGPASSWORD).

POSTGRES_DB.description: Initial database created on first boot. Also used as PGDATABASE for Paperless-ngx.

PGDATA.description: Postgres data directory. Must be a subdirectory of the volume mount path so lost+found stays outside PGDATA.

PGHOST.description: Postgres internal hostname (Railway private domain). Shared with Paperless-ngx via companion-mapping.

PGPORT.description: Postgres port. Shared with Paperless-ngx via companion-mapping.

PGUSER.description: Postgres username for Paperless-ngx. Shares the POSTGRES_USER value. Shared with Paperless-ngx via companion-mapping.

PGPASSWORD.description: Postgres password for Paperless-ngx. Shares the POSTGRES_PASSWORD value. Shared with Paperless-ngx via companion-mapping.

PGDATABASE.description: Postgres database name. Shares the POSTGRES_DB value. Shared with Paperless-ngx via companion-mapping.
